tests: release-verify in tarball mode makes no registry poll

consumesExternalOutput.program: npm cache add, npm view and npm install against the public registry, spawned by scripts/release-verify.sh
consumesExternalOutput.provenance: scripts/release-verify.sh is a *.sh that spawns npm, so rule (f)'s shell arm binds it. The stub npm in the named test is built from the same real capture as the registry-wait witness (npm 11.18.0, node v26.6.0, 2026-09-23) and answers every registry request as not served, so any poll in tarball mode is visible twice: as a call in the stub's log, and as a wait that would expire. TWO MEMBERS: member 0 makes tarball mode run the blocking wait; member 1 leaves the wait alone and adds a single non-blocking registry query to the tarball arm, which only the stub's call log can see.
